title: Traffic Signal Timing and Modification
description: Use this service request to report signal timing/sync issues or to modify an existing traffic signal for a pedestrian crossing light, signal warning flasher, left turn signal, thru/right turn signal and bicycle lane signal. ***Contact name, email address and/or daytime phone is required if any additional information is needed*** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 10 business day.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about traffic-signal timing or an existing signal modification.
actions.why: For timing or synchronization problems such as short green, long red, poor signal progression, night-flash timing, or pedestrian crossing time, or a physical modification to an existing bicycle, pedestrian, left-turn, through/right-turn, or warning-flasher signal. The 311 request form asks for the signal type or timing problem, location, direction, time of day, and duration. The description requests contact details if follow-up information is needed.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Traffic Signal Timing and Modification"
